# montecarlo_starburst_galaxy_credentials (Resource)

Starburst Galaxy credentials are the login Monte Carlo stores for Starburst Galaxy connections to use. The password is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `host` (String) Hostname of the database endpoint.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of the database user. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `password_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `port` (Number) Port the database listens on.
- `user` (String) Database user Monte Carlo logs in as.

### Optional

- `db_name` (String) Database to connect to.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
